purpose: Current sanitized Warframe context for ordinary ChatGPT and personal analysis.
instructionsForChatGPT: Treat liveState as observational and currentLoadouts as the latest synchronized account snapshot.
When they disagree, state the timestamps and confidence instead of silently choosing one.
Use the deeper linked files when the question needs owned mods, Arcanes, Rivens, resources, or alternate configurations.
Do not infer ownership from recommendations; use the published account files.
